title: Transfer by the department of education.
bodyText: The department of education may transfer a minor to the minor's home school if the minor has been enrolled in a school based on an invalid caregiver affidavit.
bodyHtml: [§302A-484]  Transfer by the department of education.  The department of education may transfer a minor to the minor's home school if the minor has been enrolled in a school based on an invalid caregiver affidavit. [L 2003, c 99, pt of §1]
